  102:     private static function encryptZip(ZipArchive $zip): void
  103:     {
  104:         $pass = self::zipPass();
  105:         if ($pass === '' || !method_exists($zip, 'setEncryptionIndex') || !defined('ZipArchive::EM_AES_256')) return;

  107:         for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
  108:             @$zip->setEncryptionIndex($i, ZipArchive::EM_AES_256);

  112:     private static function zipAll(string $zipPath, string $sqlPath): array
  113:     {
  114:         if (!class_exists('ZipArchive')) {
  115:             return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'افزونه ZipArchive روی این هاست فعال نیست؛ فقط بکاپ دیتابیس ممکن است.'

  119:             return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'ساخت فایل ZIP ناموفق بود.'];
  120:         }
  121:         $zip->addFile($sqlPath, 'database.sql');
  122:         $count = 1;
  123:         foreach (self::projectFiles() as $rel) {
  124:             if ($zip->addFile(APP_ROOT . '/' . $rel, $rel)) $count++;
  125:         }
  126:         $zip->setArchiveComment('VPN Shop full backup ' . now());
  127:         self::encryptZip($zip);
  128:         $zip->close();
  129:         if (!is_file($zipPath)) return ['ok' => false, 'message' => 'فایل ZIP ساخته نشد.'];
  130:         return ['ok' => true, 'path' => $zipPath, 'files' => $count, 'size' => (int)@filesize($zipPath)];
